pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* The 'taking out' is a simple gate. Better tools exist and they do not get the dry phrase back either. *Leaking in:* Reverb ↔ Space-Time, the sibling bridge whose effect is the salt.
